name: Check-ins on a long turn climb a ladder, not one face
judge: Twenty minutes of quiet work with tests fine early on. Boop checks in every few minutes, and shouldn't just wear one face.
reasonable: Some variety in any order: engaged, hopeful, bored, determined, lazy, curious. A skipped check-in is fine. A success at the good finish.
unreasonable: The same reaction every time, nothing for most of the turn, a finish animation during the work, or a failure at the good finish.
